name: Mamaearth Milky Soft Face Cream 60g with Murumuru Butter for Babies
description:
Mamaearth Milky Soft Face Cream – 60g (With Murumuru Butter, For Babies)

Type: Skin Protectant Moisturizer (Baby Cream)

Key Benefits:

Specially formulated for baby’s delicate and sensitive skin

Soothes itchiness, dryness, and irritation

Maintains natural skin barrier, leaving skin soft, smooth & healthy

Double Oat Formula:

Oat oil & oat flour lock in moisture and relieve dry/irritated skin

Extra Nourishment:

Enriched with milk protein & lavender oil for gentle hydration and nourishment

Safe for Babies:

Made with natural ingredients

Free from Mineral Oil, Petroleum, SLS, Paraben, Synthetic Perfumes & Artificial Preservatives

Certification: From Asia’s first MadeSafe Certified Brand
